none: PAS FindID 1012659: Roman coin: nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian, emperor right, issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN V[---]. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right [dragging captive and holding labarum]. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 15.6mm, Weight: 1.48gms, die axis: 6
